post_clip.description: A motorcycle (or scooter) suddenly enters the frame from the right and collides with the front passenger side of the silver SUV parked in the center lane. The impact is visible at ~5.5s–6.0s, with the rider appearing to be thrown or falling onto the wet pavement. This constitutes a road accident (vehicle collision) as defined.

A silver SUV is actively colliding with a black sedan parked in front of it; the SUV's front bumper is pressed against the rear of the black car, and the driver-side door of the SUV is open with a person standing beside it, suggesting an ongoing or just-completed vehicle collision in traffic.
